rationale.conceptual: The method uses a widely-adopted DFT functional (GGA-PBE) with an open-source code; the theory is textbook and no novel algorithms are needed.
rationale.execution: The pipeline requires running a series of DFT calculations (30+ volumes), fitting an EOS, and computing band structures with careful convergence; multiple scripts and post-processing steps are needed.

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT-GGA calculation for LiBC equation of state and band gap closure; methodology and execution are routine in computational materials science.

compute_estimate.reasoning: DFT calculations on a 4-atom unit cell with moderate k-point grid and plane-wave cutoff require only moderate CPU memory; no large input datasets.
